description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader to make a significant impact on patient care and facility success.
The ideal candidate will be instrumental in maintaining high standards of quality care, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance. This role offers a competitive salary and the chance to join a supportive environment focused on excellence.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Proven leadership experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Demonstrated ability to manage financial performance, staff development, and quality assurance programs.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Frostburg, MD. This vital leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.

The ideal candidate will be a Registered Nurse (RN) with a passion for geriatric care and a commitment to excellence. You will play a key role in staff supervision, quality assurance, and maintaining regulatory compliance, contributing significantly to the overall success and reputation of the facility. This is an excellent opportunity to advance your leadership career in a supportive setting.
requirements: Previous experience in a supervisory or leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations
Commitment to quality patient care and staff development
